input_origin: The retained 60-row perennial input preserves original raw masses. Working root_weight changes only for samples 187 and 208 relative to the historical input.

correction_preserved.note: The previously corrected working mass is retained; the negative raw subtraction is preserved for provenance and is not used for modeling.

baseline_saved_results: Orchard rows remain unchanged from the archived selected outputs. Hedgerow rows in the three B_shift_gamma/full JSON tables use the saved two-correction fit from October 21.
sensitivity_saved_results: Orchard rows remain unchanged. Hedgerow rows use the completed October 27 five-addition check outputs; full hedgerow tables are supplied in saved_results/hedgerow_checks.
diagnostic_saved_results: Orchard rows remain unchanged. Hedgerow rows use the completed October 27 conditional simulations, with three zeros and seed 20261117.
portable_adaptations: Read the bundled CSV instead of relying on prior session objects or embedded annual data.
Retain the full Gamma model and mass-scale starting anchor; omit historical additive and Tweedie comparisons.
Restrict sensitivity functions to the two perennial systems and the five original mass additions.
Use the original explicit perennial diagnostic seeds (20261116 and 20261117), retaining conditional simulations and the floor check.
Define functions without fitting or simulation on source; new results use a separate outputs_rerun directory.
The input reader expects four orchard zeros and three hedgerow zeros after the two documented working-mass corrections.
run_saved_hedgerow_checks.R can repeat the selected checks from the supplied corrected main fit, writing separate outputs.
verification_scope: Saved-output mapping, raw-field preservation and R syntax/input checks. No model fit, residual simulation or statistical test was run during this synchronization.
source_cells_role: Historical notebook readbacks before the two October 27 author-confirmed hedgerow corrections.

author_confirmed_corrections.basis: The author checked both masses against a weighing record. The record itself was not independently inspected.

corrected_hedgerow_fit.model: Gamma(log), site_type * depth_factor + (1|core), ML, constant dispersion, no zero inflation.
corrected_hedgerow_fit.contrasts: Equal weights across depth intervals on the log scale; ratios are not integrated root stocks.

historical_result_archive_note: Existing archive ZIPs retain the earlier source data and four-zero outputs unchanged. They are history, not the corrected current hedgerow results.
